UX Run 1 / D-1.2: the link a verified payment sends opens a code challenge on the contact channel on file; the same segment shows a case to a verified identity session. No customer material is processed here.
UX Run 1 / D-1.4: phone or email, then a code, then every case of that identity; login and recovery are one route. No password exists anywhere.
UX Run 1 / D-1.5: rendered only when the verified identity holds more than one case; one case redirects to it.
UX Run 1 / U2: issues a six-digit code to the channel on file for a link token or a contact; it never reveals whether a contact exists and never carries the token in a query string.
UX Run 1 / U2: a valid code opens a rolling thirty-day session bound to the identity, not the case; five attempts, ten-minute codes.
UX Run 1 / U5: re-issues the case link from the received screen for the funnel cookie's own case, rate-limited; a failed send never blocks payment verification.
Site S3.4 / D-2: the thread where a refusal becomes a question. Renders requests and their answers; it opens none by itself, and the engine writes none until run 16.
Site S3.4 + S2.3: the case's documents after payment, behind the verified identity session. Adding one is the same review screen the funnel uses.
Site S3.4: renders the case_report_projection and computes nothing. Today every topic is awaiting_verification, so the screen shows that and no figure.
Site S3.4 / D-2: answers one open request on the thread. It cannot open one — only a refusal does — and the case comes from the verified session, never from the body.

Site S2.3: points the funnel's case cookie at a case the verified identity owns, so a document added after payment walks the same review screen the funnel walks. It accepts no file and stores nothing.
Site S4 (ב.12): where the reminder's opt-out link lands. It resolves no token and reveals nothing; the token is passed through to a POST so a link prefetcher cannot opt anyone out.
Site S4 (ב.12): records the opt-out for the case a reminder token names. It peeks at the token rather than spending it, and answers ok for every token so liveness cannot be probed.
